name: GALLERY REGRESSION REPAIR
changes: Repairs the confirmed product-gallery regression found by comparing v15.4.0 with RC1.18
Restores the full subtle zoom timing: desktop 1.045 to 1.075 and mobile 1.02 to 1.045 over 1.25 seconds
Uses decoded double buffering and a two-frame paint barrier so the first or previous image cannot flash during commit
Keeps src as the authoritative source after gallery mount to prevent hero srcset from overriding thumbnail selection
Adds an automated gallery transition regression check and synchronizes frontend, PWA and backend release versions
